# Octavian Paccius

[Notables](../Notables.md)

*Game data as of 1 May 310.*

<!-- Generated by build_wiki.py. Edit the lore file, not this page. -->

Midshipman, commanding officer of [Beacon 001](../Ships/Beacon-001.md).

Born to [House Corvane](../Houses/Corvane.md), by surname.

Traits: Martial Artist and Rude.

Commanding officer of [Beacon 001](../Ships/Beacon-001.md), lost with his ship at [Abernoth](../Systems/Abernoth/Abernoth.md) on 13 May 311 when an unknown ship armed with energy weapons destroyed her. He was the first officer of the Accord to die at a hostile hand.

## Skills

Exceptional at production and crew training. Strong in light tactical.

## Connections

Very well connected: patrons in high places smooth every step of a career.
